description: Flood Damage Risk Mapping along the River Niger (2024-2025) is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley Data. This dataset contains information used for the quantitative estimation of flood risk along the Niger River upstream of the city of Niamey, Niger. The data was collected as part of the SLAPIS Project through field surveys, interviews with farmers and processing of data extracted from satellite images. The dataset includes three folders: 1. Coverage: Niger. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley Data. Its tags are Land Cover Analysis, Cover Crop, Damage to Building, Damage Classification, Flood Risk Management. The repository dates the deposit 2025; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
